title: Robert Monroe and The Gateway Experience
content: Has anyone else read any of Robert Monroe’s books? I’m going through the gateway process now and in reading his first book, some of his experiences reminded me of Mall World. Specifically how he talked about a college or school, because I know there’s some kind of college or learning center around the back of the mall. Also interesting is that people who have gone to The Monroe Institute and participated have told stories of actually meeting up together in mall world or wherever and they could recall back shared experiences when asked. With surprising details. What I’m getting at is: Who wants to try to meet up in mall world? It’s possible. It would be really awesome to find someone else who has read the books or done The Gateway experience and we could figure this out.
